description: Use when you need a US macro time series (pairs with Korea's Bank of Korea series). Input: series (unemployment_rate, cpi, core_cpi, payrolls, avg_hourly_earnings, ppi, public_debt, avg_rate_bills, avg_rate_notes, avg_rate_bonds), optional start, end (years, max 10-year span, default last 3 years). Output: JSON title, unit, frequency, observations [{period,value}], latest and source attribution. Data: BLS and US Treasury Fiscal Data. Example: ?series=cpi&start=2024 Price: $0.0018 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

series.description: Series id (see enum; BLS or Treasury)

name: us_macro_series
title: US macro series: unemployment, CPI, payrolls, PPI (BLS) and public debt, Treasury average rates
